description: This source file contains assorted utility functions for string manipulation, file and directory handling, validation, and generating tokens, used internally within a larger PHP project such as OpenCart.

methods.name: oc_token
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random token string of specified length.

methods.name: oc_get_ip
methods.description: Retrieves the client's IP address considering various headers set by proxies or services like Cloudflare.

methods.name: oc_strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string using multibyte encoding.

methods.name: oc_strpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring within a string with multibyte support.

methods.name: oc_strrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the last occurrence of a substring within a string with multibyte support.

methods.name: oc_substr
methods.description: Returns part of a string using multibyte support.

methods.name: oc_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase considering multibyte characters.

methods.name: oc_strtolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase considering multibyte characters.

methods.name: oc_file_read
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file if it exists.

methods.name: oc_file_write
methods.description: Writes content to a file, with optional append mode.

methods.name: oc_file_delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified file if it exists.

methods.name: oc_directory_read
methods.description: Recursively reads directory contents, with optional regex filtering.

methods.name: oc_directory_create
methods.description: Creates a directory and necessary parent directories with specified permissions.

methods.name: oc_directory_delete
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and its contents.

methods.name: oc_validate_length
methods.description: Validates the length of a string against minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: oc_validate_email
methods.description: Validates an email address, including IDN support.

methods.name: oc_validate_regex
methods.description: Validates a string against a regular expression pattern.

methods.name: oc_validate_ip
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid IP address.

methods.name: oc_validate_filename
methods.description: Checks if a filename contains only allowed characters.

methods.name: oc_validate_url
methods.description: Validates if a string is a well-formed URL.

methods.name: oc_validate_path
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid SEO-friendly URL path.
